scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @animepoodle/web" "npm run dev -w @animepoodle/api"
scripts.build: node scripts/check-wasm.mjs && npm run build:web && npm run build:functions
scripts.test: tsx --test apps/api/src/*.test.ts scripts/*.test.ts && cargo test --manifest-path crates/recommender/Cargo.toml
scripts.build:functions: wrangler pages functions build functions --outdir .wrangler/pages-worker && node scripts/package-worker.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages functions scripts tests *.json *.jsonc *.ts *.md
